d: A headless, four-armed demonic entity with a muscular, athletic build. The body is a deep terracotta brown with glowing orange veins on the chest, featuring a floating black and purple horned mask above the neck. The entity wears a gold loincloth with a matching belt, draped with purple fabric, and purple and black leggings with gold diamond accents. A detached head mask with curved purple horns floats in the air, and the upper pair of arms are encased in black and purple armor with floating circular rings at the wrists. BODY COLOR: deep terracotta brown LEGS: plantigrade with black clawed feet
